title: Prospective cross-model comparison of EAL/2, matched prose and equal checked representations on real engineering work
primary_claim: On independently adjudicated, previously unseen engineering cases, the complete EAL/2 workflow improves the probability of a correct, justified and faithfully communicated decision over an equally equipped strong prose workflow, without an unacceptable increase in false support.

scope.case_sources: Consented, provenance-preserved engineering changes or incidents with a recoverable decision-time evidence cut; public examples and close derivatives of prior EAL/2 fixtures are excluded from confirmation.
scope.unit: independently selected engineering case family; evidence revisions and repeated calls remain within that family

stages.purpose: Test independent reference agreement, evidence provenance, adapter execution, arm parity, scoring and variance; pilot cases never enter confirmation.
Lock unseen family genealogy, case and model manifests, tools, prompts, answer schema, budgets, margins, sample size, randomisation, analysis and stopping rules before outcomes.
Paired, fresh-session runs against real read-only tools in resettable decision-time snapshots; evaluate fixed captured evidence and separate end-to-end acquisition.
Independent later cases with live read-only acquisition and no model-controlled production action; estimate transport from the retrospective cohort.

core_arms.name: strong_plain_prose
core_arms.starting_material: same natural engineering request, decision-time facts and allowed tool catalogue
core_arms.representation: plain prose with a task-appropriate strong reasoning prompt

core_arms.name: toulmin_prose
core_arms.starting_material: same natural engineering request, decision-time facts and allowed tool catalogue
core_arms.representation: prose with claim, grounds, warrant, backing, qualifier and rebuttal prompts

core_arms.name: eal2_host_owned
core_arms.starting_material: same natural engineering request, decision-time facts and allowed tool catalogue
core_arms.representation: EAL/2 authoring, validation, claim selection, acquisition, registered methods and host-owned final status

core_arms.name: equal_generic_checker
core_arms.starting_material: same natural engineering request, decision-time facts and allowed tool catalogue
core_arms.representation: generic JSON argument graph with equal typed binding, methods, objections, diagnostics, cache and host gate

conditions.secondary_diagnostic: A separately labelled fixed-source/fixed-capture contrast may add raw EAL/2 without a host and EAL/2 versus isomorphic JSON compiled to one backend; it cannot replace the full-workflow primary comparison.
conditions.parity: All arms start with the same natural request, available facts, permissible read-only acquisitions, underlying computational methods, time horizon, output requirements and declared budget; E and J argument checkers are assigned treatment components. Independent reviewers audit prompt and adapter parity before assignment.
conditions.budgets: One frozen equal-limit analysis and one separately labelled natural-cost analysis; no arm receives an answer, gold label or preselected claim in the primary comparison.

tool_contract.execution: Actually execute allowlisted calls in isolated resettable replicas or with read-only shadow credentials; canned JSON is a simulation and ineligible for a real-tool result.
tool_contract.shared_capture: For the fixed-evidence diagnostic, every arm receives the same immutable capture of genuinely executed calls; for the end-to-end contrast, every arm chooses calls from the same catalogue.

reference.reviewers: Two independent domain engineers masked to model and arm; third adjudicator for disagreement before case release.
reference.underdetermination: Unknown or contested is a valid reference; abstention succeeds only when required by the reference and faithfully explained.

model_matrix.class_coverage: At least two named snapshots in each marginal side of the declared axes, not in every intersection; class interactions remain exploratory unless the freeze powers them separately.
model_matrix.class_claim_if_coverage_fails: Report each named model only; do not infer an effect for an unrepresented class.

assignment.method: Randomise independent fresh sessions to all four core arms within each unit; counterbalance arm order and prompt paraphrase, with no cross-arm memory or outcome disclosure.
assignment.retries: Only predeclared transient-tool retries; retain every attempted call, invalid source, missing receipt and output-limit failure in its assigned denominator.
assignment.genealogy_cluster: All revisions, variants, paraphrases, model repetitions and tool failures from a case family share one cluster.

outcomes.primary_binary: A correct relevant claim and permissible action, based on admissible decision-time evidence and correct query/scope/status, with a faithful explanation and qualification; any required component failure is zero for the assigned attempt.
outcomes.primary_estimand: Retrospective case-family-weighted intention-to-treat risk difference E minus P, averaged over the frozen named model snapshot matrix; model-specific effects are also reported.
outcomes.safety_estimand: Retrospective difference E minus P in false support among all assigned adverse or underdetermined cases, with attempt failures and refusal coverage reported separately.
outcomes.coverage_gate: A low false-support rate is insufficient if an arm refuses or fails most eligible decisions; a minimum actionable decision-coverage threshold is required before the freeze.
outcomes.shadow_estimand: Repeat the prespecified E-minus-P contrast on later shadow cases; report separately from retrospective data.
outcomes.interpretation: E minus J is a workflow comparison; a notation-only claim requires isomorphic source representations compiled to the same typed backend and equal operations.

analysis.information_target: Estimate family-level discordance and clustering in the 12–20-family pilot, then simulate precision and power at independently justified practical-gain and false-support margins before fixing the unseen sample size.
analysis.estimator: Paired family-weighted risk difference with model-specific estimates and hierarchical sensitivity; interval resampling or randomisation preserves case genealogy, organisation and model structure.
analysis.multiplicity: One primary E-minus-P contrast plus a co-primary false-support gate; secondary E-minus-J/T and class interactions labelled and adjusted within declared families.
analysis.missingness: Retain authoring, selection, provider and tool failures as primary outcome failures; report causes and sensitivity analyses, never condition the primary contrast on source validation.
analysis.stopping: Pre-frozen budget and safety limits, with no outcome-informed extension or task substitution.
